title: C4 Therapeutics, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: C4 Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 10, 2026, disclosing a bylaw amendment approved on April 9, 2026, designating the U.S. District Courts for the District of Massachusetts and the District of Delaware as exclusive forums for securities law disputes. The amendment was adopted in response to recent amendments to Delaware corporate law regarding forum selection provisions.
key_points: Board of Directors approved bylaw amendment on April 9, 2026, effective immediately
Amendment designates District of Massachusetts and District of Delaware as exclusive forums for securities law complaints
Amendment covers causes of action arising under the Securities Act of 1933 and Securities Exchange Act of 1934
Company retains right to consent in writing to alternative forum selection
Change was made in response to amendments to Delaware General Corporation Law
Signed by Kendra R. Adams, CFO and Treasurer, on April 10, 2026
